finite_repetition_uncertainty: Three repetitions per cohort per (training_seed, checkpoint_round). Within-client spreads are std-of-n_reps with ddof=0 (n_reps persisted in per_client_rep_count). Per-client mean delta vectors are deduped by (seed, round, client_id, rep_seed); collisions with disagreement beyond tolerance must be zero in a correct run and are recorded in dedup_inventory.dedup_collisions. The trajectory cohort is reported separately but is EXCLUDED from the stochastic repetition estimators since it is a single observation per (seed, round) per cohort. The artifact is NOT a complete variance decomposition: client-mean distances between reps reflect only the partition-time composition of each cohort, not the underlying client likelihood.

estimator_definitions.per_client_norm_per_rep: ||theta_c^rep - sd0|| over parameters with requires_grad=True only; one per (seed, round, client_id, rep_seed) signature.
estimator_definitions.per_client_norm_mean_std_cv: Arithmetic mean / std (ddof=0) / std/mean across the deduped (seed, round, client_id, rep_seed) entries for client c.
estimator_definitions.per_client_mean_delta_vector_norm: L2 norm of the element-wise mean of the deduped per-rep (client_sds[c] - sd0) vectors for client c computed ONLY within (seed, round).
estimator_definitions.per_client_vector_spread: sqrt( (1/n) * sum_rep ||delta_c^rep - mu_c||^2 ), where mu_c is the per-client mean delta vector AND n is the count of unique (rep_seed) entries within the specific (seed, round).
estimator_definitions.per_pairwise_mean_distance: L2 distance between deduped mean delta vectors for distinct clients within the same (seed, round) and within the same cohort (or across cohorts if cohort membership is empty / not enforced).
estimator_definitions.per_client_norm_mean: Arithmetic mean of per-client per-rep L2 norms (mirrored separately from per_client_norm_mean_std_cv for legacy callers).
estimator_definitions.per_client_norm_std: std (ddof=0) of per-client per-rep L2 norms; NaN when only one rep (mirrored separately).
estimator_definitions.per_client_norm_cv: std divided by mean; NaN when undefined (mirrored separately).
estimator_definitions.cohort_aggregate_per_rep: delta_agg(cohort, rep) = sum_c w_c * delta_c^rep; w_c = counts[c] / sum_{c' in cohort} counts[c']; computed within the (seed, round).
estimator_definitions.cohort_aggregate_vector_spread_within_co: sqrt( (1/n) * sum ||delta_agg^rep - mu_cohort||^2 ); if n == 1 returns NaN.
estimator_definitions.between_cohort_aggregate_vector_norm_dif: For each (round, rep_seed) shared by >=2 cohorts WITHIN THE SAME (seed, round), record ||agg_a - agg_b|| for every cohort pair.
estimator_definitions.trajectory_summary: Reported separately: per-client update norm and L2-norm of per-client post-state minus pre-state for the saved trajectory cohort; NO within-client spread (the trajectory is one observation per (seed, round)).
